title: introduce-certchain-reencryption-operator-zero-downtime-helm-terraform
author: Evan Marshall
description:
Motivation: Private deployments require a safe, zero-downtime path to rotate and re-encrypt full certificate chains when customers swap CAs or replace HSM-backed keys. This PR introduces a coordinator operator (certchain-reencrypt-operator) plus accompanying Helm hooks and Terraform module updates that perform staged re-encryption of sealed secrets and Vault transit data using envelope encryption backed by HSM/KMS. The design goals are: zero-traffic disruption, idempotent upgrades, short rollback windows, and an offline migration path for air-gapped installs.

What this changes: - New k8s operator (CRD) that orchestrates staged re-encryption of Secret objects and sealed-secrets (optional) while coordinating rolling restarts via PodDisruptionBudgets and Helm pre/post hooks. - Terraform module updates to emit new GRANT policies and rotate envelope-key metadata in state with safe promotion steps. - Helm chart changes including two new hooks (pre-upgrade dry-run, post-upgrade finalize) and a flag to opt into operator-managed re-encryption. - Vault helper script and migration plan for transit rewraps (supporting both Vault and external HSM devices). - Dry-run and validation mode to preview number of objects, estimated downtime (should be 0), and expected transient KMS calls. - E2E harness updates and unit tests for the operator reconciliation loop.

How it works (high-level): 1) Install/upgrade with operatorEnabled=true. 2) Operator creates a staging envelope key (ephemeral key wrapped by the customer HSM/KMS) and annotates Secrets to mark rewrap-needed. 3) Operator re-encrypts Secret payloads using envelope key and writes back, coordinating with Helm to perform rolling restarts for services that read those Secrets (via annotated Deployments/StatefulSets). 4) Once all targets confirm readiness, operator promotes the new envelope metadata and deletes staging key material. 5) Terraform changes update IAM/KMS GRANTS and store promotion checkpoints in state so subsequent runs are no-ops. 6) For Vault transit rewraps, helper converts transit keys with staged key rotation and verifies data integrity via checksums.

Rollback and safety: - All mutating steps are reversible: operator keeps previous encrypted copies until finalize. - A configurable grace period can be set to automatically roll back if certain health checks fail. - The operator supports a --manual-finalize mode for high-security customers needing human approval.

Checklist: - [x] Operator implementation and CRD - [x] Helm hooks and chart values - [x] Terraform module GRANT changes and state migration helpers - [x] Vault/HSM migration script and runbook - [x] Unit + integration tests + e2e harness updates - [x] Docs and upgrade notes

Note: This PR intentionally splits the heavy lifting into smaller commits so the operator logic can be reviewed independently from the Terraform and Helm updates. See related Linear items ENG-1428 (operator design) and ENG-2210 (terraform state migration).
commits: feat(operator): initial CRD and controller loop for staged re-encryption
feat(helm): add pre-upgrade dry-run and post-upgrade finalize hooks
chore(terraform): add kms/grant propagation and migration helper
fix(operator): handle secret reconciliation when pod templates unchanged
test(e2e): add certchain rewrap scenario to e2e-harness
docs: add runbook and upgrade notes for certchain re-encryption
review_comments: Marta: can we avoid writing plaintext to disk in the migration helper? Author: migration helper now uses in-memory streams and atomic writes to temp secrets.
Sofia: need stronger pod disruption coordination for statefulsets. Author: added PDB checks and added support to annotate StatefulSets.
Ravi: Terraform state promotion step is risky for old providers. Author: added a --dry-run-state flag and idempotent checkpointing in state file with clear rollback path.
Security review (Ana): request for KMS audit events; Author: added KMS API call logging and an optional audit-sink to customer's logging endpoint.
release_notes: Adds a Certchain Re-encryption Operator that enables staged, zero-downtime certificate/key rewraps for sealed-secrets and Vault transit. Includes Helm hooks, Terraform state migration helpers, and a documented upgrade path with dry-run. Safe by default with rollback windows and manual-finalize option.
tests: unit: operator reconciliation coverage added (75% for new controller)
integration: migration against a mock KMS and Vault transit
e2e: full rewrap scenario with real Helm chart and sample workloads (CI mocked HSM)
